title: Drop a field with a MySQL migration
prompt: The app runs on MySQL and deploys with migrations (see migrations/). The `color` field of notes is no longer used: remove it from the model, and add the migration file migrations/0002_drop_color.sql with exactly the SQL `inferlo db migrate drop_color --allow-drop` would generate for this MySQL app, and update migrations/snapshot.json the same way, so that running `inferlo db migrate` afterwards finds no changes. You cannot run commands.
